name: Ouri
source:
"Please let go. I want to see the results."

A man who served as the miko for Shiraki Hiyori 1,000 years ago. He looks very similar to Mashiro, but they are not related by blood. His final moments were not recorded anywhere and are still shrouded in mystery.

His tone is gentle, but his personality is rather tight. He's good at gambling and is undefeated against humans. . There is also an anecdote that he challenged the gods to a duel...

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_ouri.png]official website[/url]]
